market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Fed hike creates 1-2 week digestion period. Dow's 700-pt intraday drop shows sensitivity. Oil weakness supports equities but rate repricing pressures multiples. Expect 5-8% VIX spike. Munis and gold outperform. Crypto choppy around $80K BTC. Watch for second-guessing on Fed path.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive but bifurcated. AI infrastructure and energy transition remain structural themes. Fiscal sustainability concerns (Gundlach) suggest next recession will be sharper. Consumer selectivity persists 12+ months. Defense spending elevated. Housing correction likely 6-12 months out given 12-month low sentiment. Japan fiscal funding shift and China unemployment create global growth drag.
